Subject: HQ visit request: May 3-4 — demo + short lab access

Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for the quick call yesterday. We'd like to bring a five-person delegation to Redwood HQ the week of May 3 — ideally May 3rd (morning) or May 4th (afternoon). The goal is a 90-minute technical demo, followed by an informal 45-minute walk-through of your inference lab (networked racks, quantization setup) for two of our infra engineers.

Can you confirm:
- Available rooms with AV for May 3 morning or May 4 afternoon
- Visitor badging and parking (we may have one van)
- Whether the lab walk-through is possible (requires escort and a short NDA addendum)

I've attached our standard NDA and the visitor list to speed things up. Procurement is cc'd for the vendor-risk questions.

Appreciate it — Alicia

Hi Alicia — great to hear. Thanks for sending the NDA and the list. Quick answers up front:
- We have the Rowan Conference (capacity 12) free on May 3 from 9:30–11:30 and the Harbor Suite (large AV + streaming) free May 4 from 1:30–3:30.
- Parking: we can reserve 2 visitor passes + 1 van pass for loading; we'll confirm plate numbers once you share them. ShuttleCo can provide a shuttle from SFO if you want — I can loop them in.
- Lab access: short escorted walk-through is fine for two of your engineers but requires our lab addendum to the NDA and pre-approved background checks for those two. Evelyn runs lab escorts and Karthik handles the forms.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm preferred date/time (May 3 morning or May 4 afternoon).
2) Sign the attached Redwood lab addendum (we'll send a DocuSign).
3) Provide plate numbers and the two names for lab access.

Putting Monica, Evelyn and Karthik on this thread to coordinate logistics. I can lock a room once Alicia confirms.

Thanks,
Dylan

Dylan / team — note a couple of operational constraints: 
- Rowan Conference has in-room cabling that will need on-site AV support; I'll book an AV tech for May 3 at 9am if we pick that slot.
- Harbor Suite has livestream obligations that afternoon (internal town hall at 2pm) so we'd have to use 1:30–2:30 only if we go May 4; not ideal for a 90-minute session.
- Lab escorts require a 24h notice for background check results (badge provisioning) — Karthik, can you confirm turnaround if Alicia's team submits forms tomorrow?
- Parking: driveway loading zone is limited 8–10am and 4–6pm. If they arrive outside those windows we'll have to coordinate with Facilities.

If we need the full 90 + 45, May 3 morning is the safer bet. I'll tentatively reserve Rowan for 9:30–12:00 pending confirmation.

Monica
